datasets.label: ALMA · molecular gas
datasets.title: The Southern Pinwheel's molecular gas
datasets.description: ALMA's picture of M83 in the light of cold gas molecules, the gas that stars form from, as ESO published it on 5 October 2026 with the carbon monoxide survey of Koda et al. (2025). It lies as one flat image on the disc the photograph uses, tilted 24°. The orange is the publisher's color, and the picture's brightness is drawn as opacity.
datasets.summary: ALMA's picture of the galaxy's cold molecular gas, flat on its disc; nothing in it has depth.
